background.texture: thin grid plus faint defensive shield shadow

prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 carbon-grid scene for a defensive clean-sheet comparison. The editorial variant uses defensive energy and a stylised shield: a charcoal shield assembles from warm-white plates, slate rivets and a lime rim, pulsing once as Spanish labels ARCOS EN CERO and DEFENSA rise with mask motion. This editorial block has no statistical axes, no sample claims and no invented saves. The statistical variant replaces the shield with paired count bars for clean sheets on a shared partidos scale: {{home.clean}} for Liverpool FC and {{away.clean}} for Manchester City FC. Labels are Spanish with team names and unit partidos. A source/sample line cites Bzzoiro and attaches sample sizes {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} directly to the facts; counts are never converted into rates. The comparison remains count-to-count with one focal bar pair. Transition from editorial to statistical is a wipe; entry is a wipe; exit collapses. Camera does fixed plus parallax with tilt 1deg, keeping the upper two-thirds readable and the lower quarter reserved for yellow subtitles. Beats: entry shield assembly; build Spanish kinetic words; main bars grow sequentially with count-up; exit lime rim glow fade. Signature move glow-pulse. Emphasis words ARCOS and DEFENSA use bracket. Motion spring damping 22, stiffness 180, mass 0.6; countUp true; stagger 70; scaleFrom 0.95. The visual language stays restrained, professional and faithful to source and sample, with no predictive claim.
